tellyscope.description:
Tellyscope is a free, open-source Android app that helps you manage, debloat, and customize your Android TV, Google TV, or Fire TV directly from your phone. It connects over your local Wi-Fi network using Android Debug Bridge (ADB), without requiring root access or a computer.

Discover compatible TVs, review unwanted preinstalled applications, and safely disable selected apps using device-specific recommendations. Changes are recorded in a history panel, allowing you to undo actions or restore disabled system apps. Tellyscope also lets you install APKs, transfer files between your phone and TV, monitor device resources, and manage installed applications.

Additional tools include switching the default home launcher, configuring ad-blocking Private DNS, clearing app caches, adjusting animation speeds, and capturing TV screenshots.

The app has no advertisements, accounts, or tracking. It is licensed under GPL-3.0 and requires Android 8.0 or newer on the phone, a compatible TV on the same network, and enabled ADB debugging. Some functions depend on the TV model and Android version.
